fato_historico: 1976: The Tangshan earthquake measuring between 7.8 and 8.2 moment magnitude flattens Tangshan in the People's Republic of China, killing 242,769 and injuring 164,851.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos hums with a reminder of human strength today. Much like the earth itself shifts and reshapes, you may find your own foundation undergoing a gentle transformation. It is a good time to acknowledge your capacity to rebuild and rise stronger, finding beauty in the process of healing and moving forward with newfound courage.
frase_do_dia: Even the strongest mountains remind us that every shaking earth can find peace again.
significado_numero: Represents cycles of completion and the courage to start anew.
conselho: Consider your challenges as stepping stones toward your own emotional growth and inner peace.
